name: scheduler-get
description: Read one scheduled job in full by ID: the whole task text and payload, schedule, linked task, and the last run's summary, context and outcome. Use it to quote a routine's instructions, to review a job or a bad run, and before a scheduler-update that passes task_payload. Fields listed in truncatedFields were cut to fit; the task text never is.

outputs.job: object (scheduler-list summary plus task, taskPayload, lastRunSummary, lastRunContext, progress)
